# PyRUA-Lean

Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens

**2026-10-01 · Preprint · Not reported**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01939)** · [Project](https://dagroup-pku.github.io/PyRUA-Lean/) · [Code](https://github.com/DAGroup-PKU/PyRUA-Lean) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/DAGroup-PKU/PyRUA-Lean-Coder-v0.1-4B)

Uses Python cells to compose existing robot primitives with control flow and selective feedback, reducing repeated model calls relative to tool-by-tool execution.

<img src="../../../website/public/images/catalog/pyrualean-policy.webp" width="760" alt="Figure 2: Uses Python cells to compose existing robot primitives with control flow and selective feedback, reducing repeated model calls relative to tool-by-tool execution."/>

**Scope and qualifications**

- Token and call savings are calculated over jointly solved instances; success rates use all instances.
- The frozen Astra result and trained compact-coder result must not be conflated.
